label: UniFi U7 Pro Max
description: UniFi U7 Pro Max (U7-Pro-Max) - 1x 2.5G RJ45. 802.3at PoE-in; WiFi 7; up to 8.6 Gbps PHY rate; 25 W max.
notes: PoE draw read 2026-11-28 from https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/wifi/u7-pro-max (HTTP 200, 660,217 B): the specification table prints "Power Method: PoE+" and "Max. Power Consumption: 25W". 25 W is that figure and it sits on eth0, the single RJ45 the same table's Networking Interface row names. Until this pass the port carried no poeIn at all, so engine/media.js fell back to its 12.95 W 802.3af class default and the model drew 12.95 W whatever the datasheet said. Nothing in the engine compares a PD's draw with the class its PSE declared, so cabling this AP to an 802.3af port is still accepted; the number changes the budget arithmetic, which is the one thing a PoE lab asks of it.
